note: Declared HS 491191 (printed matter/pictures) and industry 'Строительство и DIY' do not match the actual business: SatSure is an Earth-observation / satellite analytics and decision-intelligence software company (products SatSure Skies, SatSure Sage, Dhaarini; upstream subsidiary KaleidEO building EO payloads). It sells analytics, APIs and dashboards, not printed goods or DIY/construction products, so the declared HS code appears to be a misclassification rather than a trade record. Per Rule 3 this is not grounds for rejection — company stays in the base with HS corrected to reflect software/IT services (no goods HS applicable; if a code is mandatory, 998314/998313 IT-enabled services would be the factual category, to be confirmed by the analyst, not asserted here). Per Rule 5: no traces of physical shipments found on either export or domestic side — no customs/B-L records, no GST turnover band, no GeM/CPPP awards, no published contract values. Website claims of '85 Mn hectares analyzed annually' and '2.1 Mn farmers impacted' are marketing statements, not shipment evidence, and are recorded as declared, not confirmed.
